chain.title: The Wastes Grow Teeth
chain.desc: Mine the quartz crystal growths added to the top layer of the Nether Wastes; broken without Silk Touch they yield vanilla quartz.

chain.title: Cut of the Hoglin
chain.desc: Raw hogham drops from hoglins and is also brushed out of bastion remnant and crimson forest dig sites.

chain.title: Something Is Buried Here
chain.desc: Suspicious soul sand generates at excavation sites across the soul sand valley and is worked with a brush.

chain.title: Brushed From the Dust
chain.desc: Stridite is a brushing reward from soul sand valley, mega fossil and black ice glacier dig sites, and is the alloy base for netherite plating.

chain.title: Seams in the Bone Beds
chain.desc: Fossil fuel ore is placed as underground decoration throughout the soul sand valley and the black ice glaciers.

chain.title: Fuel of the Long Dead
chain.desc: Mining fossil fuel ore drops fossil fuel, which crafts torches, soul torches and ancient torches in place of coal.

chain.title: Hollow and Walking
chain.desc: Vessels are hostile spirits that spawn in the soul sand valley and the black ice glaciers, and they drop wraithing flesh.

chain.title: Meat That Remembers
chain.desc: Dropped by vessels, looted from sanctum supply chests, or crafted from banshee powder and rotten flesh.

chain.title: Answer the Screaming
chain.desc: The banshee is a hostile soul sand valley spirit whose loot table is the only source of the banshee rod.

chain.title: Grind the Wail
chain.desc: Crafted one-to-two from a banshee rod, the way blaze powder is made from a blaze rod.

chain.title: Glass Made of Ghosts
chain.desc: Craft banshee powder with a slime ball for two phasmo shards, which then craft into soul glass and phasmo arrows.

chain.title: Bottled Haunting
chain.desc: Scoop a bucket from the ectoplasm lakes that generate in the soul sand valley and the black ice glaciers.

chain.title: Catch a Wandering Light
chain.desc: Capture one of the passive wisps drifting through the soul sand valley; the mod calls this an exorcism.

chain.title: Lead Them By the Bones
chain.desc: Craft a fishing rod with a skeleton skull to make the lure that tames a stampede.

chain.title: The Cold That Should Not Be
chain.desc: Harvested in the black ice glaciers sub-biome; four icicles craft into two black ice blocks.

chain.title: The Needle Points Down
chain.desc: A loot modifier injects the sanctum locator compass into nether fortress chests, and it also generates in chapel chests.

chain.title: Halls Beneath the Waste
chain.desc: The stone the sanctum structure is built from, also stocked in its supply chests.

chain.title: Roots in the Crypt
chain.desc: A rare wart that grows in the sanctum's underground crypts and can be replanted on soul sand.

chain.title: Immune to the Air Itself
chain.desc: Brewed from warped wart into an awkward antidote, then refined into immunity against a specific status effect.

chain.title: Win the Candle's Wager
chain.desc: Light a treacherous candle with flint and steel and survive its trial; harder trials pay out more flame.

chain.title: Only Fire Opens It
chain.desc: Brazier chests are scattered through the sanctum and will only open when a treacherous flame is used on them.

chain.title: The Artifact in the Ash
chain.desc: A rare brazier chest artifact, roughly a one-in-twenty pull, and the only source for shotgun crafting.

chain.title: Fist Full of Thunder
chain.desc: Craft a shotgun core with two netherite ingots and a skeleton skull to build the mod's signature weapon.

chain.title: Rack It and Fire
chain.desc: Smith the shotgun-fist with a pump-charge upgrade template and a treacherous flame, both brazier chest loot.

notes: Item set = 286 ids from assets/netherexp/models/item/*.json intersected with item./block. keys in assets/*/lang/en_us.json; entity ids from entity.netherexp.* keys (14 found). Every id above is set-membership verified. Ordering was derived from the jar's own advancement tree in data/netherexp/advancements/nether/ (root -> soul_sand_valley -> {rattling_remnants -> gravedigger, ghost_mucus -> exorcism -> rodeo_stampede, frightening_rush -> enter_soul_glass / blind_shot, ssv_sub_biomes, emf_raider -> occult_manor -> {the_caduceus -> plague_doctor, rekindled_betrayal -> eldritch_manipulation -> angel_with_a_shotgun -> the_nether_is_full -> ultra_overkill, hp_minecraftian -> lorekeeper}}), plus the jar's recipes, entity and archaeology loot tables, the sanctum_compass_in_fortress loot modifier and the forge biome modifiers (ectoplasm_lake, fossil_fuel_ore, fossil_ore, quartz_crystal, vessel/apparition spawns). WebSearch on netherexp.wiki.gg supplied three facts the jar does not encode: antidotes are brewed from warped wart found in the sanctum crypts, treacherous flame comes from beating a treacherous candle's trial, and brazier chests only open with a treacherous flame (shotgun core drop rate 4.60% exposed / 5.62% hidden). DROPPED: netherexp:jackhammer_fist (only appears in two item tags, no recipe or loot source in the jar and no wiki page content found), netherexp:soul_ruby_ore, netherexp:explosive_scoria and netherexp:blightwart (ids verify but have no block loot table or recipe in the jar, so no honest how-obtained sentence). No dim: entries - the jar contains no netherexp dimension; its three new biomes (black_ice_glaciers, exhaust_mire, sorrowsquash_pastures) are injected into minecraft:the_nether. Entities used for kill: entries were checked against entity.netherexp.* lang keys and against their loot tables (banshee -> banshee_rod, vessel -> wraithing_flesh).
